jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Bay6.ai is a 1+ years old company at the forefront of AI technology, delivering solutions that help businesses leverage the power of artificial intelligence. As Director, AI Strategy & Delivery, you will set the strategic direction of our AI practice and serve as the principal technical authority across our client portfolio. You will decide which capabilities Bay6.ai builds in-house, which we source through partners, and how our offerings evolve as the agentic tooling landscape matures, and you will then architect and help build the solutions that follow. The role suits someone who has stayed deliberately technical on the way to leadership.

You will own AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across concurrent engagements spanning agentic automation, conversational AI, and predictive modeling. You will advise client executives on where AI creates defensible value and where it does not, sequence their investment roadmaps, and shape solutions in presales by running technical discovery and building the prototypes that win the work. You will then carry those engagements into delivery and stay close enough to the implementation to clear blockers yourself. You will also inherit workstreams where ownership is currently implicit rather than documented, and you will have the latitude to define them.

Job Responsibilities

Set the strategic direction of Bay6.ai's AI practice, including which capabilities to build in-house, which to source through partners, and how the offering portfolio evolves as the agentic tooling landscape matures.
Advise client executives on AI strategy and roadmap, sequencing investments and distinguishing where AI creates defensible business value from where it does not.
Work closely with Product Owners, Delivery Managers, Bay6.ai Leadership, and other Engineering Leads to unblock technical challenges by providing direction and solutions.
Own technical architecture and AI solution governance across all client engagements and set the standards that make that role repeatable rather than personal.
Design and oversee production agentic systems, including intake, outreach, escalation, and feedback-loop agents, with error handling and pre-deployment compliance gates.
Build and unblock critical-path work personally across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets management, integrations, and model development.
Lead technical presales by running discovery with prospects, gathering requirements, and building the prototypes that convert opportunities into engagements.
Define and lead workstreams where ownership is currently implicit, making scope explicit before committing the business to it.
Maintain portfolio discipline across concurrent engagements, closing, merging, or reprioritizing stale work rather than allowing it to accumulate, and operating from program level down to individual tickets as the work requires.
Run client-facing AI governance, including participating in steering committees, AI Center of Excellence artifacts, standards and guidelines, and KPI and value frameworks, and report portfolio health and architecture risk to Bay6.ai leadership.

Required Experience:

Minimum 8+ years in technology delivery, including substantial time as a hands-on architect or senior engineer with significant leadership experience in Gen AI and ML technologies.
A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and defending it to executive audiences, including build-versus-buy, platform selection, and partner decisions.
Ownership of AI/ML solution architecture on client-facing engagements, carried from presales through to production.
Experience advising executive stakeholders on AI investment priorities and roadmap sequencing.
Production experience designing multi-agent or agentic AI systems, including orchestration, escalation paths, error handling, and human-in-the-loop feedback.
Current hands-on capability with cloud-native delivery: Kubernetes and Helm, containerized CI/CD, AWS, and secrets management patterns.
Practical machine learning experience sufficient to review, correct, and ship model work.
A track record of establishing AI governance artifacts such as standards, guidelines, ethics charters, and KPI and value frameworks for enterprise or institutional clients.
Comfort operating through influence rather than formal authority, including with offshore development centers and third-party vendors.
A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.

Technical Skills Requires:

Kubernetes and Helm; containerized deployment and promotion
AWS, including ECR, Secrets Manager, and External Secrets Operator patterns
CI/CD pipeline design, including image build, scanning, and deployment
Agentic AI frameworks and LLM application architecture
Python and the machine learning toolchain, including XGBoost and model evaluation
API design and integration; conversational AI and chatbot platform configuration
Encryption standards and secrets management practices
Jira for program and sprint management, and portfolio planning tools

Other information:

Will have direct reports (6 to 7) - AI Engineers across USA, LATAM, EU and India
Base Salary, Bonus, Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(K)

jobs.title: Re:CAM - Vice President of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

We hire builders. If you need a fully-scoped plan before you'll move, this isn't the role. We need leaders who turn ambiguity into action, stay close to the work, and build the systems that make scale possible — fast.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles )

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own the development, launch, and scale-up of a new venture-scale opportunity in the CAM space. The right candidate will have demonstrated experience commercializing novel technology coming out of a research group, end-to-end. You are startup oriented, with experience shipping MVPs and then scaling them to thousands of users. The ideal candidate will have experience or strong familiarity with CAD/CAM space or in a tangential field using 3D modeling, simulation, and spatial data. You have excellent communication and conflict resolution skills. You are hungry and willing to roll up the sleeves and build with a talented cross-functional team.

What You Get To Do

Define the technology architecture required to bring a novel CAM product to market
Develop and implement a technology transfer strategy, from R&D to final product
Manage all elements of the software development process
Directly manage a team of software development engineers
Work closely with stakeholders to align product vision and commercial targets with an engineered solution
Partner with the GM and executive stakeholders to build a new venture-scale business

What You Bring To The Team

15+ years leading the development of highly technical engineered software products
A master's degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong full stack fundamentals (you can meaningfully review a hard MR)
Bonus points for some familiarity with C++
Advanced knowledge of modern architecture and trends
Advanced knowledge of AI tooling, applications, and trends
Ability to lead, grow and motivate a team
Excellent executive communication and conflict resolution skills
Prior experience in CAD/CAM or a related 3D space
Strong desire to build a venture scale business with a small team over the next several years

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

The base salary range for this position is $192,223 to $288,334 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Vice President, Business Development and Alliance Management
jobs.description:
The Role

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Business Development and Operations, the Vice President, Business Development will lead the identification, development, negotiation, and execution of major strategic transactions that expand the reach and value of Xaira’s platform.

This role will focus primarily on originating and executing significant AI platform, technology, and multi-program partnerships. Unlike a traditional biotechnology business development role centered on individual asset licensing, this leader will develop complex partnerships built around Xaira’s differentiated scientific and technical capabilities, with the potential to span multiple platform technologies, programs, disease areas, and stages of research and development.

The Vice President will work closely with the SVP of Business Development and Operations, executive leadership, scientific and technical leaders, and legal and finance partners to shape partnering strategy, identify high-value opportunities, and lead transactions from initial engagement through negotiation, execution, and transition to alliance management.

The ideal candidate combines strong transaction leadership with the ability to understand differentiated science and technology, translate Xaira’s AI and drug development capabilities into strategic and commercial value, and develop creative deal structures with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, technology, and other strategic partners.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development Strategy
Partner with the SVP of Business Development and Operations to develop and execute Xaira’s business development strategy.
Identify opportunities for major AI platform, technology, research, and multi-program partnerships.
Translate Xaira’s scientific and technical capabilities, including its
AI-enabled discovery and development capabilities,
into clear and compelling partnership opportunities.
Develop a prioritized pipeline of potential partners and transactions aligned with Xaira’s long-term strategy.
Assess market trends, competitive activity, partner needs, and emerging business models across TechBio, AI, and biopharma, including the evolving landscape for AI-driven drug discovery partnerships.
Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership regarding partnership opportunities, deal structures, and market positioning.

Deal Origination and Partner Engagement
Proactively originate significant partnership opportunities with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, technology, and other strategic organizations.
Build and maintain senior-level relationships with decision-makers across the biopharma and technology ecosystem.
Lead early discussions with potential partners to understand their scientific, technical, and business priorities, including opportunities to apply AI across research and development.
Develop partnership concepts that connect external needs with Xaira’s platform, expertise, and strategic priorities.
Build opportunities beyond traditional single-asset licensing, including platform collaborations, multi-program partnerships, technology alliances,
AI-focused collaborations, and other strategic transactions.
Represent Xaira at industry meetings, partnering conferences, and other external forums.

Transaction Leadership
Lead major transactions from initial concept and partner engagement through diligence, negotiation, internal approval, and execution.
Develop creative deal structures that may include upfront payments, research funding, milestones, royalties, option rights, co-development arrangements, and other economic components.
Ensure deal structures appropriately reflect the long-term value of Xaira’s platform, AI capabilities, and intellectual property.
Lead cross-functional transaction teams involving scientific, technical, legal, finance, operations, and executive stakeholders.
Develop transaction strategies, valuation frameworks, negotiation positions, and executive recommendations, including approaches for valuing differentiated AI technologies and platform capabilities.
Prepare materials for executive leadership and Board review.
Maintain momentum, accountability, and clear decision-making throughout complex deal processes.

Cross-Functional Leadership
Work closely with scientific and technical leaders to define the scope, objectives, deliverables, and resource requirements of potential partnerships, including partnerships involving
AI models, technologies, and workflows.
Partner with finance to assess deal economics, valuation, resource commitments, and financial scenarios.
Partner with legal to negotiate agreements that protect Xaira’s intellectual property and long-term strategic flexibility, including considerations related to AI-generated insights and outputs.
Ensure proposed partnership commitments are aligned with internal capabilities and company priorities.
Build alignment across stakeholders on transaction strategy, economics, risks, and decision points.
Support the transition of executed partnerships into alliance management and ongoing governance.

Alliance Management
Lead the transition of executed transactions from deal teams into effective alliance management, ensuring continuity between the original strategic intent and partnership execution.
Establish and maintain governance structures, decision-making processes, communication plans, and escalation pathways for strategic alliances.
Serve as a senior point of contact for external partners and build trusted, productive relationships across scientific, technical, operational, and executive stakeholders.
Partner with internal teams to track contractual obligations, deliverables, milestones, resource commitments, and financial considerations.
Ensure partnerships involving AI-enabled research, technologies, and development programs remain aligned with agreed objectives, responsibilities, data requirements, and measures of success.
Identify and resolve risks, misalignment, and execution challenges before they affect partnership outcomes.
Identify opportunities to expand successful alliances into additional programs, technologies, disease areas, or
AI-driven collaborations.
Provide senior leadership with clear updates on alliance performance, risks, decisions, and opportunities for continued value creation.

Platform Positioning and Market Development
Help define how Xaira presents its platform, capabilities, and partnership model to the external market.
Develop clear and differentiated narratives for scientific, technical, executive, and business audiences, including the role of AI in advancing drug discovery and development.
Identify new partnership models that reflect the evolving intersection of biotechnology, artificial intelligence, data, and drug discovery.
Strengthen Xaira’s position as a strategic partner for complex, AI-enabled research and development collaborations.
Build market awareness of Xaira’s capabilities and the potential value of partnering with the company.

Qualifications

Significant experience in business development, corporate development, licensing, strategic partnerships, or a related role within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, TechBio, or a relevant technology organization.
Demonstrated experience leading and closing large, complex strategic transactions.
Strong experience originating and executing sell-side business development opportunities.
Experience with platform, technology, AI, research collaboration, multi-program, or discovery-stage partnerships strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience managing strategic alliances from transaction execution through ongoing governance, delivery, and expansion.
Ability to understand complex scientific and technical capabilities, including AI-enabled technologies, and translate them into strategic and commercial value.
Strong knowledge of transaction structures, valuation principles, financial terms, intellectual property considerations, and deal governance.
Experience working closely with scientific, technical, legal, finance, operations, and executive teams.
Established credibility and relationships across the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or technology partnering ecosystem.
Strong executive presence, judgment, negotiation skills, and written and verbal communication.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where strategy, technology, AI capabilities, and partnership models continue to evolve.
Advanced scientific or technical degree, MBA, JD, or equivalent experience is valued but not required.

Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, seeking to provide an open, flexible, and friendly work environment to empower employees and provide them with a platform to develop their long-term careers. A Summary of Benefits is available for all applicants. We offer a competitive package that includes base salary, bonus, and equity. The base pay range for this position is expected to be $250,000 - $325,000 annually; however, the base pay offered will vary depending on the market, job-related knowledge, skills and capabilities, and experience.

Xaira Therapeutics an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that our strength is in our differences. Our goal to build a diverse and inclusive team began on day one, and it will never end.

TO ALL RECRUITMENT AGENCIES: Xaira Therapeutics does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias or employees. Xaira Therapeutics is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
Overview

Cedar Pine is seeking a Head of Technology to serve as the firm’s senior technology leader and oversee the strategy, execution, and day-to-day management of the firm’s technology function. This role will lead an established IT function, oversee cybersecurity strategy and controls, and help shape the firm’s approach to AI and emerging technology. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic, technically credible leader who is equally comfortable developing people, reviewing technical work, evaluating vendors, and presenting a clear technology roadmap to firm leaders. The Head of Technology will manage and develop a small, growing team, partner with firm leaders on business priorities, and ensure technology capabilities are scalable, secure, and aligned with Cedar Pine’s long-term objectives

Cedar Pine requires five days per week onsite in Northbrook for this role.

Responsibilities

Technology Leadership and Strategy

Define, maintain, and communicate the firm’s technology roadmap in alignment with business priorities established by Cedar Pine’s leadership.
Own technology planning, budgeting, vendor relationships, and software and infrastructure procurement decisions.
Serve as the senior escalation point for technology matters across Cedar Pine and its affiliated entities.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation expectations, and governance processes that support consistent, high-quality delivery.

Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Controls

Own and continuously improve Cedar Pine’s cybersecurity strategy, standards, policies, and controls across infrastructure, applications, data, identity, endpoints, and cloud environments.
Assess cybersecurity risk, prioritize remediation, and ensure vulnerabilities, access controls, incident response readiness, and business continuity considerations are addressed proactively.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to manage security operations, third-party technology risk, cyber insurance requirements, audits, and security-related due diligence.
Embed security, privacy, data governance, and operational risk requirements into the technology roadmap, AI adoption, software selection, infrastructure decisions, and day-to-day technology operations.

AI and Emerging Technology

Develop and lead Cedar Pine’s enterprise-wide AI strategy by assessing internal needs, identifying opportunities to embed AI into workflows, and setting priorities for practical adoption across the firm.
Provide technical guidance and quality oversight for AI-enabled development, including LLM integrations, workflow automation, and agentic tools where appropriate.
Train and support employees in the effective, responsible use of AI, including maintaining ongoing education as AI capabilities, tools, and risks evolve.
Advise firm leadership on the AI and emerging technology landscape, including relevant opportunities, limitations, business value, and implementation risks.
Evaluate AI features introduced by existing platforms and third-party vendors before adoption, ensuring they meet Cedar Pine’s standards for security, privacy, and data governance.

People Leadership and Team Development

Lead, coach, and develop the IT Manager through clear expectations, regular feedback, and a genuine investment in continued professional growth.
Support the IT Associate’s development in partnership with the IT Manager, reinforcing a cohesive and well-functioning IT team.
Foster a team culture grounded in clear communication, accountability, continuous improvement, intellectual curiosity, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Evaluate and make recommendations on technology stack, frameworks, tools, and third-party integrations for new and existing projects.
Maintain sufficient technical fluency to assess quality, identify risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and make credible build-versus-buy decisions.

Qualifications & Skills

10+ years of progressive experience in technology roles, including at least five years in a leadership, strategic development and people management capacity.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop individuals across varying experience levels, with a leadership style that builds trust and brings out the best in others.
Hands-on software development experience, including production code contributions and proficiency in at least one modern web stack such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Node.js.
Practical knowledge of AI tools and LLM-based applications, with an ability to assess how these systems work, where they create value, and where they introduce risk.
Experience overseeing IT infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity fundamentals, system reliability, and technology operations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and create practical documentation that teams will use.
Track record of managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, procurement processes, and cross-functional technology initiatives.

Additional Benefits

Cedar Pine believes in embracing an environment that empowers our employees to amplify their potential and create enduring value for our Firm and its investments. One of the many ways we invest in our culture and people is through a competitive, comprehensive benefits package such as:

Subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
Ancillary benefits such as Life Insurance, short and long-term disability, FSA plan, and 401(k) program
Paid time off, sick leave, holidays
Discretionary bonuses based on employee contributions, time-in-role, and company performance
Long-term bonus program designed to reward employees for time spent with the Firm
Daily onsite lunch stipend program
“Last mile” transportation coverage for those commuting via train
Gym membership reimbursement program
Education and Tuition reimbursement program to further our employee’s development in areas related to their role in the company
Regular onsite and offsite cultural events hosted throughout the year to provide opportunities for employee networking outside of office hours
A variety of charitable giving programs and opportunities to volunteer and give back on behalf of the firm

Compensation Range

$225,000

and $2

50,000 annually. Compensation is dependent on qualifications, experience, and other factors. The salary offered will align with the Company’s budgeted amount for the position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Cedar Pine is committed to equal employment opportunity in both principle and as a matter of policy. We will recruit, hire, train, promote, compensate and provide benefits to all applicants and employees without regard to ancestry, sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, religion, religious creed, mental and/or physical disability, medical condition, military and/or veteran’s status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all recruiting, hiring, promotions, upgrades, layoffs, compensation, benefits, terminations and all other privileges, terms and conditions of employment. The firm complies fully with all federal, state and local equal employment opportunity laws.

Cedar Pine is a private investment firm specializing in strategic, long-term assets. Headquartered near Chicago, Cedar Pine’s team strives to create value by applying and building on decades of unique expertise as operators and investors in healthcare, finance, and other industries. Cedar Pine is not an investment adviser and does not accept outside capital.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Wonder | Founding Team
Employment Type:
Full-time Stage
: Pre-Seed
Start Date: Immediate / As Soon As Possible
Compensation: Equity pre-funding + competitive salary following
financing Location
: Remote / United States

About Wonder

Wonder is a journey inward before it becomes a journey toward another person.

Wonder is a relationship technology company reimagining how people find and build meaningful connection.

Most dating platforms begin with a profile and optimize for more: more profiles, more swipes, more matches, more time spent searching.

We are building around a different premise.

Before we ask who you’re looking for, we ask who you are.

Wonder combines psychological depth, AI-powered matchmaking, and ongoing reflection to understand people beyond surface-level preferences and introduce them with greater intention. Our Five Elements framework explores the different environments that shape a person, while our Mirror™ system identifies patterns across those signals to build a richer understanding of compatibility.

We would rather show you nobody than somebody we don’t believe you should meet.

This isn’t about more matches. It’s about better ones.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Founding Chief Technology Officer to become Wonder’s first senior technical leader and take ownership of translating an ambitious product vision into a scalable technology platform.

This is not a co-founder position. It is an early executive and founding-team role with significant technical ownership and influence.

Wonder already has an established Founder/CEO, product thesis, brand, philosophy, and initial product architecture. The Founding CTO will join at an unusually formative stage and have substantial influence over how the technology is designed, built, and scaled.

Our timeline is aggressive, intentionally.

We are looking for someone who can begin essentially immediately.

Wonder is actively preparing for a pre-seed raise, and we intend to launch our first product in a matter of months, not years.

This is not an opportunity for someone looking to spend the next several months discussing what we might eventually build. We are entering an execution-intensive period now.

The person who joins us should be prepared to rapidly assess what exists, establish the technical architecture, determine the path to MVP, begin building, recruit additional engineering talent where necessary, and move toward launch.

Speed matters.

So does getting the foundation right.

We need someone capable of doing both.

What You’ll Own

You will have substantial ownership over Wonder’s technical strategy and execution, including:

Architecting and leading development of Wonder’s consumer product and supporting infrastructure
Establishing a realistic technical roadmap from current stage through MVP and launch
Translating Wonder’s product concepts and behavioral frameworks into robust technical systems
Developing the infrastructure behind personalization, compatibility, recommendation, and matching
Designing data architecture capable of responsibly handling highly personal user information
Determining where AI and machine learning genuinely improve the product
Building for security, privacy, reliability, and scalability
Establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing, deployment, monitoring, and technical documentation
Evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and selecting the appropriate technology stack
Recruiting and eventually leading Wonder’s engineering organization
Working directly with the Founder/CEO on product strategy, technical feasibility, hiring, fundraising, and company-level decisions
Communicating Wonder’s technical architecture and roadmap to investors when appropriate

At this stage, you will need to build as well as lead.

This is not an executive-management position detached from the codebase. The Founding CTO should be capable of personally getting into the architecture and product while simultaneously thinking several stages ahead.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re less interested in pedigree than demonstrated technical judgment and the ability to build.

You should have meaningful experience building modern software products and be comfortable operating where the roadmap is ambitious, resources are constrained, and many of the most consequential technical decisions still need to be made.

Experience in several of the following would be particularly valuable: full-stack product development, native or cross-platform mobile applications, consumer technology, cloud architecture, recommendation and matching systems, machine learning and LLMs, data infrastructure, security and privacy, social products, and early-stage startup engineering.

Previous experience taking a product from zero to launch is particularly compelling.

You should also be comfortable with ambiguity.

Wonder is attempting something technically and philosophically difficult. Some problems will have obvious engineering solutions. Others will require experimentation, intellectual curiosity, and the willingness to challenge assumptions.

The Person

Technical ability is necessary. It isn’t sufficient.

Wonder is being built around curiosity about human beings. The people building it should possess some of that curiosity themselves.

We’re looking for someone who is:

Intellectually rigorous. Deeply curious. Low-ego. Decisive. Resourceful. Fast-moving. Emotionally perceptive. Comfortable with responsibility.

You should care about why something is being built, not simply whether it can be built.

You should be comfortable working alongside a founder with a strong product, philosophical, and creative point of view while bringing an equally strong technical perspective to the company.

That relationship should involve candor, trust, healthy disagreement, intellectual independence, and exceptionally high standards.

Most importantly, you should want to build.

Compensation & Equity

Wonder is currently pre-seed and actively preparing to raise institutional capital.

Before financing, this position will be compensated primarily through meaningful but conservative early-stage equity, structured with appropriate vesting and subject to final legal documentation.

Following successful financing, the position will transition to a competitive full-time salary plus equity, appropriate to the company’s stage and the individual’s experience.

We want to be transparent about what joining this early means.

There is meaningful potential upside. There is also genuine early-stage startup risk, uncertainty, intensity, and a tremendous amount of work to do.

The right person will understand both.

Why Join Now?

Most people who eventually work at Wonder will arrive after many of the consequential decisions have already been made.

You won’t.

The Founding CTO will help determine how the first product is architected, how our intelligence layer develops, what our engineering culture becomes, who joins the technical organization, and how Wonder moves from an idea into the hands of its first users.

If we succeed, you’ll be able to point to the technical foundation of the company and say:

I built that.

There’s no greater intimacy than being understood.

We’re rebuilding dating around it.

How to Apply

Please do not rely solely on LinkedIn Easy Apply.

In addition to submitting your application, send a personal email directly to the Founder/CEO at mollym.mulholland@gmail.com with your resume and a written cover letter.

Your email should tell us, in your own words:

Why you believe you are the right person to become Wonder’s Founding CTO
Your background and the experiences that have prepared you to build and lead technology at this stage
What you believe you can contribute to Wonder, both technically and as an early company leader
Why Wonder specifically, including what about the product, problem, or philosophy genuinely interests you
What you have built before and what you learned from building it
When you can start

Please include relevant GitHub repositories, shipped products, portfolio work, technical writing, or previous startups where applicable.

Generic or AI-generated cover letters will not be competitive. We want to understand how you think, what you care about, and why you want to build this company.

We are reviewing candidates on a rolling basis and intend to move quickly.

If you’re interested, reach out now.

Establish engineering standards, development practices, documentation expectations, and governance processes that support consistent, high-quality delivery.

Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Controls

Own and continuously improve Cedar Pine’s cybersecurity strategy, standards, policies, and controls across infrastructure, applications, data, identity, endpoints, and cloud environments.
Assess cybersecurity risk, prioritize remediation, and ensure vulnerabilities, access controls, incident response readiness, and business continuity considerations are addressed proactively.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external vendors to manage security operations, third-party technology risk, cyber insurance requirements, audits, and security-related due diligence.
Embed security, privacy, data governance, and operational risk requirements into the technology roadmap, AI adoption, software selection, infrastructure decisions, and day-to-day technology operations.

AI and Emerging Technology

Develop and lead Cedar Pine’s enterprise-wide AI strategy by assessing internal needs, identifying opportunities to embed AI into workflows, and setting priorities for practical adoption across the firm.
Provide technical guidance and quality oversight for AI-enabled development, including LLM integrations, workflow automation, and agentic tools where appropriate.
Train and support employees in the effective, responsible use of AI, including maintaining ongoing education as AI capabilities, tools, and risks evolve.
Advise firm leadership on the AI and emerging technology landscape, including relevant opportunities, limitations, business value, and implementation risks.
Evaluate AI features introduced by existing platforms and third-party vendors before adoption, ensuring they meet Cedar Pine’s standards for security, privacy, and data governance.

People Leadership and Team Development

Lead, coach, and develop the IT Manager through clear expectations, regular feedback, and a genuine investment in continued professional growth.
Support the IT Associate’s development in partnership with the IT Manager, reinforcing a cohesive and well-functioning IT team.
Foster a team culture grounded in clear communication, accountability, continuous improvement, intellectual curiosity, and pragmatic problem-solving.
Evaluate and make recommendations on technology stack, frameworks, tools, and third-party integrations for new and existing projects.
Maintain sufficient technical fluency to assess quality, identify risks, guide architectural tradeoffs, and make credible build-versus-buy decisions.

Qualifications & Skills

10+ years of progressive experience in technology roles, including at least five years in a leadership, strategic development and people management capacity.
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop individuals across varying experience levels, with a leadership style that builds trust and brings out the best in others.
Hands-on software development experience, including production code contributions and proficiency in at least one modern web stack such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Node.js.
Practical knowledge of AI tools and LLM-based applications, with an ability to assess how these systems work, where they create value, and where they introduce risk.
Experience overseeing IT infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity fundamentals, system reliability, and technology operations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and create practical documentation that teams will use.
Track record of managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, procurement processes, and cross-functional technology initiatives.

Additional Benefits

Cedar Pine believes in embracing an environment that empowers our employees to amplify their potential and create enduring value for our Firm and its investments. One of the many ways we invest in our culture and people is through a competitive, comprehensive benefits package such as:

new_jobs.description:
Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Wonder | Founding Team
Employment Type:
Full-time Stage
: Pre-Seed
Start Date: Immediate / As Soon As Possible
Compensation: Equity pre-funding + competitive salary following
financing Location
: Remote / United States

About Wonder

Wonder is a journey inward before it becomes a journey toward another person.

Wonder is a relationship technology company reimagining how people find and build meaningful connection.

Most dating platforms begin with a profile and optimize for more: more profiles, more swipes, more matches, more time spent searching.

We are building around a different premise.

Before we ask who you’re looking for, we ask who you are.

Wonder combines psychological depth, AI-powered matchmaking, and ongoing reflection to understand people beyond surface-level preferences and introduce them with greater intention. Our Five Elements framework explores the different environments that shape a person, while our Mirror™ system identifies patterns across those signals to build a richer understanding of compatibility.

We would rather show you nobody than somebody we don’t believe you should meet.

This isn’t about more matches. It’s about better ones.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Founding Chief Technology Officer to become Wonder’s first senior technical leader and take ownership of translating an ambitious product vision into a scalable technology platform.

This is not a co-founder position. It is an early executive and founding-team role with significant technical ownership and influence.

Wonder already has an established Founder/CEO, product thesis, brand, philosophy, and initial product architecture. The Founding CTO will join at an unusually formative stage and have substantial influence over how the technology is designed, built, and scaled.

Our timeline is aggressive, intentionally.

We are looking for someone who can begin essentially immediately.

Wonder is actively preparing for a pre-seed raise, and we intend to launch our first product in a matter of months, not years.

This is not an opportunity for someone looking to spend the next several months discussing what we might eventually build. We are entering an execution-intensive period now.

The person who joins us should be prepared to rapidly assess what exists, establish the technical architecture, determine the path to MVP, begin building, recruit additional engineering talent where necessary, and move toward launch.

Speed matters.

So does getting the foundation right.

We need someone capable of doing both.

What You’ll Own

You will have substantial ownership over Wonder’s technical strategy and execution, including:

Architecting and leading development of Wonder’s consumer product and supporting infrastructure
Establishing a realistic technical roadmap from current stage through MVP and launch
Translating Wonder’s product concepts and behavioral frameworks into robust technical systems
Developing the infrastructure behind personalization, compatibility, recommendation, and matching
Designing data architecture capable of responsibly handling highly personal user information
Determining where AI and machine learning genuinely improve the product
Building for security, privacy, reliability, and scalability
Establishing engineering standards, development processes, testing, deployment, monitoring, and technical documentation
Evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and selecting the appropriate technology stack
Recruiting and eventually leading Wonder’s engineering organization
Working directly with the Founder/CEO on product strategy, technical feasibility, hiring, fundraising, and company-level decisions
Communicating Wonder’s technical architecture and roadmap to investors when appropriate

At this stage, you will need to build as well as lead.

This is not an executive-management position detached from the codebase. The Founding CTO should be capable of personally getting into the architecture and product while simultaneously thinking several stages ahead.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re less interested in pedigree than demonstrated technical judgment and the ability to build.

You should have meaningful experience building modern software products and be comfortable operating where the roadmap is ambitious, resources are constrained, and many of the most consequential technical decisions still need to be made.

Experience in several of the following would be particularly valuable: full-stack product development, native or cross-platform mobile applications, consumer technology, cloud architecture, recommendation and matching systems, machine learning and LLMs, data infrastructure, security and privacy, social products, and early-stage startup engineering.

Previous experience taking a product from zero to launch is particularly compelling.

You should also be comfortable with ambiguity.

Wonder is attempting something technically and philosophically difficult. Some problems will have obvious engineering solutions. Others will require experimentation, intellectual curiosity, and the willingness to challenge assumptions.

The Person

Technical ability is necessary. It isn’t sufficient.

Wonder is being built around curiosity about human beings. The people building it should possess some of that curiosity themselves.

We’re looking for someone who is:

Intellectually rigorous. Deeply curious. Low-ego. Decisive. Resourceful. Fast-moving. Emotionally perceptive. Comfortable with responsibility.

You should care about why something is being built, not simply whether it can be built.

You should be comfortable working alongside a founder with a strong product, philosophical, and creative point of view while bringing an equally strong technical perspective to the company.

That relationship should involve candor, trust, healthy disagreement, intellectual independence, and exceptionally high standards.

Most importantly, you should want to build.

Compensation & Equity

Wonder is currently pre-seed and actively preparing to raise institutional capital.

Before financing, this position will be compensated primarily through meaningful but conservative early-stage equity, structured with appropriate vesting and subject to final legal documentation.

Following successful financing, the position will transition to a competitive full-time salary plus equity, appropriate to the company’s stage and the individual’s experience.

We want to be transparent about what joining this early means.

There is meaningful potential upside. There is also genuine early-stage startup risk, uncertainty, intensity, and a tremendous amount of work to do.

The right person will understand both.

Why Join Now?

Most people who eventually work at Wonder will arrive after many of the consequential decisions have already been made.

You won’t.

The Founding CTO will help determine how the first product is architected, how our intelligence layer develops, what our engineering culture becomes, who joins the technical organization, and how Wonder moves from an idea into the hands of its first users.

If we succeed, you’ll be able to point to the technical foundation of the company and say:

I built that.

There’s no greater intimacy than being understood.

We’re rebuilding dating around it.

How to Apply

Please do not rely solely on LinkedIn Easy Apply.

In addition to submitting your application, send a personal email directly to the Founder/CEO at mollym.mulholland@gmail.com with your resume and a written cover letter.

Your email should tell us, in your own words:

Why you believe you are the right person to become Wonder’s Founding CTO
Your background and the experiences that have prepared you to build and lead technology at this stage
What you believe you can contribute to Wonder, both technically and as an early company leader
Why Wonder specifically, including what about the product, problem, or philosophy genuinely interests you
What you have built before and what you learned from building it
When you can start

Please include relevant GitHub repositories, shipped products, portfolio work, technical writing, or previous startups where applicable.

Generic or AI-generated cover letters will not be competitive. We want to understand how you think, what you care about, and why you want to build this company.

We are reviewing candidates on a rolling basis and intend to move quickly.

If you’re interested, reach out now.
